paper_title: Stellar limits on scalars from electron-nucleus bremsstrahlung
notes: White-dwarf luminosity function bound on a baryophilic scalar (Yukawa coupling g_B to baryon number, L = g_B phi (p-bar p + n-bar n), g_n = g_p = g_B) from electron-nucleus bremsstrahlung, Bottaro/Caputo/Raffelt/Vitagliano. Eq. (4.11a): alpha_B = g_B^2/4pi <= 3.4e-26 at nominal 95% CL, i.e. g_B <= 6.5e-13 (abstract quotes 7e-13). The bound is mass-independent for m_phi <~ 1 keV; verified from the vector paths of Fig. 3 (HiggsPortal.pdf in the e-print) that the 'WD Bremsstrahlung (this work)' curve is exactly flat over the full plotted range 1e-3 eV to 1e3 eV, so the flat line is reported over that range. The paper also bounds a leptophilic scalar (alpha_e <= 1.2e-32, g_L <= 4e-16) and the Higgs-portal mixing (sin theta <= 1.9e-10), but presents the baryophilic bound first and notes it is the most restrictive existing limit for baryophilic scalars, so g_B is taken as the main result. Stellar energy-loss bound: no dark-matter density assumed.
